title: Sections lift along a surjection whose kernel has no H^1 on the test object
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $0\to S_1\to S_2\xrightarrow{g}S_3\to0$ a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $w:W\to X$ an object of $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] such that $H^1(W_{\Et},w^{-1}S_1)=0$, with $w^{-1}$ the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and cohomology as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then $g_W:S_2(W)\to S_3(W)$ is surjective.
